summary: Open Core is still the right phase: 79 successful analyses, fresh reputation, and an empty PR list. Layer 1 stays off because the collaborative score is only 10.5 from three PR reviews and one issue. The real drag is six open cycle issues plus queue notes that still cite usage 61 and 2026-10-08. This week, close the five older issues, keep #257 as the only tracker, and refresh that stale queue snapshot by hand.
stop: Stop opening another Dev Cycle, Pulse, or Complete issue while #251–#257 are still open.
start: Close #251, #253, #254, #255, and #256 as superseded and put the only live checklist on #257.
keep: Keep Layer 1 disabled and keep human landing of the usage, reputation, and Astra chore loop.

actions.title: Close five superseded cycle issues

steps: Comment on #251, #253, #254, #255, and #256 that each is superseded by later cycle output already on main, including usage chore bc8d4c5.

Set the issue scope to the queue note that still cites usage 61 and last_computed 2026-10-08, against usage total_successful_analyses 79 and config/astra.json balance 10.5.

actions.issueTitle: Route Dev Cycle 257 to queue snapshot drift
actions.issueBody: Dev Cycle 257 is the only issue that should stay open. Its scope is the stale queue note versus usage 79 and Astra 10.5, not Layer 1.

Confirm config/astra.json balance is still 10.5 and do not recompute Astra.
Update only the stale queue snapshot to usage 79, last_updated 2026-11-04T16:50:08Z, last_type self_audit, and Astra balance 10.5.
